No.LEGIS:1(12)/02/6808-13,

3. Incorporation. ---(1)
As soon as may be from the commencement of
this Ordinance Government shall establish an Agency to be called the North -West
Frontier Province Technical Education and Vocational Training Agency.
(2) The Agency shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and
a common seal with power to acquire and hold property and shall, by the said
name, sue and be sued. The immovable property acquired by the Agency shall not
be sold by it without the approval of Government.
(3) The headquarters of the Agency shall be at Peshawar.
(4) The Agency shall work under the general superintendence and control
of Government.

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2002

2002
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Technical Education and Vocational
Training Agency in the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th September, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(12)/02/6808-13,
dated 16-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
4. Composition of the Agency.---(1) The Agency shall consist of sixteen members, including the
Chairman, to be appointed by the Government as under:--
(i) a Chairman;
(ii) five
representatives of employers to be nominated--
(a) one by the
Sarhad Chamber of Commerce and Industry, North-West Frontier Province;
(b) one by the
Industrialist Association, Industrial Estate, Jamrud Road, Hayatabad, Peshawar:
(c) one by the
Sarhad Employers Federation;
(d) one by the
North-West Frontier Province Branch of
All Pakistan Textile Mills-Association; and
(e) one by Cement Industries of North-West
Frontier Province;
(iii) Chairman,
Skill Development Agency, North-West Frontier Province;
(iv) Secretaries
to Government of the following Departments;
(a) Industries
and Technical Education Department;
(b) Finance
Department;
(c) Schools and
Literacy Department; and
(d) Planning and
Development Department;
(v) one
representative' of the North-West Frontier Province University of Engineering
and Technology to be nominated by the Vice-Chancellor of the University;
(vi) three
Chairmen of Colleges, Institute and
Centre Management Committees belonging to the following disciplines;
(a) Commerce Colleges/Institutes;
(b) Government College of Technology,
Polytechnics, Technical and Vocational Centres (Male);
(c) Government Technical and Vocational
Centres (Female); and
(viii) one representative of Institute of
Management Sciences, Hayatabad to be nominated by the Director of that
Institute.
Note.--The Director,
Technical Education and Manpower Training shall for the purposes of membership
at Serial No.(vi) above, submit a panel of three names from each discipline to
Government for appointment as members of the Agency.
(2) 'The Director, Technical Education and Manpower Training shall work
as Secretary of the Agency'.
(3) 'The names of the Chairman and members shall be notified in the
official Gazette.
(4) The term and conditions of appointment of the Chairman and members
shall be such as may be determined by Government.
(5) The term of office of the Chairman and members shall be three
years; provided that one-third of the members, other than the Chairman, shall
cease to be members after completion of two years, in whose place new
"'embers shall be appointed for a period of three years in the same manner
as was applied in the case of out-going members. The names of such out-going
members shall be decided by a draw.
(6) Notwithstanding anything to
the contrary contained in this section, Government may, at any time, remove the
Chairman for reasons to be recorded in writing or remove any member at any time
suo motu or on the recommendations of the Chairman.
(7) The Chairman may coopt four
members belonging to the relevant ex parties in relation to any matter under
consideration of the Agency, who can take part in discussion, but shall not be
entitled to vote for or against the matter tinder discussion.
(8) The quorum for the meeting of
the Agency shall be nine.

6. Functions and powers of the
Agency.---(1) The Agency shall take over all Polytechnics, Commercial
Training Institutes and Colleges, Technical and Vocational Training Centres
working immediately before the coming into force under this Ordinance tinder
the administrative control of the Directorate of Technical Education and
Manpower Training and any other institutions, offices, organizations, or
undertakings, if so notified by Government.
(2) 'The institutions taken over by the Agency under subsection (1)
shall be regulated and administered by the Agency.
(3) The Agency may set up new institutions offering subjects/courses
similar to the courses of the institutions mentioned in subsection (1).
(4) The Agency shall perform such other functions in the field of
technical and commercial education arid vocational training as may be
prescribed by the rules.

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAININGAGENCY ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Technical Education and Vocational
Training Agency in the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th September, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(12)/02/6808-13,
dated 16-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
9. Functions of the Management
Committees. ---The following shall be the broad functions of the Management
Committees:
(i) To identify
the local employment opportunities/requirements of skilled labour force:
(ii) to prepare
annual training plan based on identified training needs;
(iii) to ensure
optimum utilization of the available facilities and monitor training costs;
(iv) to prepare
annual budget estimates of the College/Institute/Centre concerned:
(v) to collect
information on effectiveness of the, prescribed training courses, to suggest
necessary changes to the curriculum and to make it need based.
(vi) to
facilitate exposure of instructional staff to the industry and update their
knowledge about latest technological developments;
(vii) to
facilitate placement of trainees in industry for on the job training;
(viii) to
enhance employment prospects of the trainees through its links with the
industry;
(ix) to generate
funds by introducing/arranging special courses and by opening service out-lets.
(x) to
co-ordinate with the non-Government Organizations (N.G.Os.), donor and other
stake-holders for the maximum benefit of the institution.

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to

Training Agency in the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th September, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(12)/02/6808-13,
dated 16-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
13. Employees of the Agency.--(1)
The Agency may employ such officers, advisors, consultants and employees in its
service as may be necessary for the efficient performance of its functions in
such manner and on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed.
(2) The services of the existing
employees of the Institutions or offices taken over by the Agency shall be
transferred to the Agency on terms and conditions which shall not be less
favourable than those admissible to them immediately before their transfer to
the Agency.
(3) The employees transferred
under subsection (2) shall continue to be employees of the Government liable to
be transferred back to Government by the Agency, unless absorbed in the service
of the Agency in such manner as may be prescribed.
(4) The Agency shall, through
adoption of policies of hiring, freeze, reassignment, restructuring of
institutions, non-replacement of employees retiring upon attainment of age of
superannuation and providing incentives for early retirement, bring the number
of its employees in conformity with the retirements of the Agency.
(5) Government shall in
accordance with the relevant rules contribute to the pension, gratuity and
final payment of provident fund, and other similar payments of the employees of
the Institutions or Officers who become the employees of the Agency under
subsection (2) for the period they served under Government.
